author: Inside Edition
description: The Stone County Sheriff in Missouri released this video of a deputy's attempt to pull over a vehicle. According to the criminal complaint, the driver was clocked at 75 miles-per-hour in a 45-mph zone, but the driver didn't stop and continued onto a bridge. Without putting the vehicle in park, the driver got out and jumped from the bridge. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspect Survives Jumping From Bridge During Traffic Stop

author: Inside Edition
description: A child has been located three years after disappearing. Andrew Escobar is now back with his father in New Mexico. Juan Escobar says his son was never returned to him after a custody visit with his mother in 2023. At the time, Mariam Felix was charged with custodial interference. It wasn't until recently that Andrew and his mother were located by authorities in Texas. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Father Reunited With Son Who Went Missing 3 Years Ago, Boy's Mother Arrested
